device_matrix.coverage: Real Android views, touch injection, key-event injection, InputConnection contracts, and an isolated SSH/tmux/vim session. OS-level USB/Bluetooth key delivery is not claimed.

verified: Independent persisted toolbar, Zen ring and composer layouts
Add/remove/drag ordering, reset and legacy button-visibility compatibility
Custom shortcuts, group visibility/order, favorites, text and explicit Enter
Editor unsaved changes survive Activity recreation
Mode-aware modifier/function key encoding, IME composition and Unicode input
Single/double/triple tap mappings, two-finger gestures, pinch and volume interception
Ctrl long press, panel lock, correct Claude/Codex presets and icons
Direction-pad corners, fold, lock and saved position
Pending gestures canceled before another PTY is attached
SSH shell/vim UTF-8 input, saved emoji, configurable tmux prefix and directional pane navigation
pending: Real USB/Bluetooth keyboard: hotplug, toolbar auto-hide, Option/Meta and OS-level shortcut dispatch
notes: A single API 27 back-stack timeout occurred during a concurrent emulator run. The complete serial rerun passed without removing the back-stack assertions.
Configured IME identifies the device environment; InputConnection tests and SSH Unicode input do not constitute a manual provider-specific IME typing claim.
Other provider preset catalogs were inspected; running every third-party CLI command is not claimed.
No release tag or remote Maven publication.
